theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid N)) (ξ : Euclid N → MultiVector N n) (G : Euclid n → Euclid N) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ), MeasurableSet M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid N), IsCompact K → μHE[n] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ (μHE[n].restrict M) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid N), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ x) Q) → LipschitzWith L G → MeasurableSet A → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖G a - G a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ A, DifferentiableAt ℝ G a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ G a)) → G '' A ⊆ M → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun u => ξ (G u)) (volume.restrict A) ∧ ∀ᵐ u ∂(volume.restrict A), IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ (G u)) (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (fun a => fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))))
